title: Human-filtered CSF metagenomic reads from a Powassan virus encephalitis case

provenance.observations: metagenomic sequencing of patient cerebrospinal fluid on hospital day 8; tutorial reports 14 million short reads originally and a released subset of 226,908 reads after human-read removal
provenance.adaptation: human reads removed by study authors; tutorial file has paired-end reads with some reads previously merged using FLASH
provenance.status: observed clinical sequencing data; published clinical case

biological_context.experimental_units: one patient CSF specimen/run context; exact sample count unknown
biological_context.design: diagnostic case investigation; patient admitted Dec 2016 with encephalitis; possible pathogen initially unknown
metadata: Tutorial reports SRA release containing 226,908 reads after host read removal; exact accession not stated in inspected page.

assets.version: tutorial asset, version/date not stated; tutorial page last edited 2026-09-07
assets.processing_stage: human-filtered short nucleotide reads for taxonomic search
assets.relationship: input to MMseqs2 nucleotide-to-protein taxonomy search

access_and_terms.access: tutorial page links direct public download; original cited study is Piantadosi et al. 2018

inspection.checked: Tutorial page sections Metagenomic pathogen detection and Assigning taxonomic labels, fetched 2026-09-30; it names read count and preprocessing and provides direct FASTA URL and MMseqs2 commands.
inspection.not_checked: FASTA bytes/records, exact SRA accession, consent/governance terms, paper supplement, file hash, or successful execution.

limitations: Human-read depletion stage and source data privacy/reuse terms need verification before task use.
Exact sample/run accession and paired-read merge details for released FASTA are not stated on the inspected page.
The tutorial asks diagnostic inference questions; scientific answer/grading oracle remains to be sourced from paper and references.
